evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Equating rehearsal with possession frames stability/security (conservation) as contingent on demonstrated mastery (competence); the matched-clause device makes the value appeal explicit.
Cadence decision appeals to stability and security through regular, recurring rehearsal — a conservation value.
Assigning a named owner appeals to accountability for capability and mastery — competence as the good being established.

mints.name: UnrehearsedCapabilityIsNoCapability
mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the value appeal here equating a capability with its demonstrated, rehearsed form — making unrehearsed capability count as no capability at all?
